speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, lower leg swelling, and weight loss. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any changes in your urine output or appearance recently?

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any foamy urine or changes in how often you need to urinate at night? Also, have you been feeling unusually short of breath or tired when doing simple tasks like walking? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, BUN, Creatinine, Albumin.
